## Edge attribute contract

`graph.Edge.Attr` is a flat JSON object (stored verbatim in `graph_edges.attr`). The keys below are typed by `model.EdgeAttrs` (`PermissionAttr`, `Exposure`, `Confidence`) and read/written with `Edge.Permission/SetPermission`, `Exposure/SetExposure`, `Confidence/SetConfidence`, `Because/SetBecause`. Other keys (`via`, `ports`, `hint`, `finding_id`, ...) are collector detail and are preserved.

| key | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `actions` | []string | actions the statement allows or denies (`s3:GetObject`) |
| `effect` | string | `Allow` | `Deny` |
| `resources` | []string | resource patterns of the statement |
| `conditions` | object | statement Condition block, verbatim |
| `statement` | string | `<policy-arn>#<sid|index>` of the enabling statement |
| `policy_arn` | string | policy the statement belongs to |
| `denied_by` | string | statement / SCP / boundary that denies, when Effect is overridden |
| `requires_conditions` | []string | condition keys that must hold for the grant |
| `unknown_conditions` | []string | condition keys the evaluator could not decide |
| `because` | string | human explanation of the hop (always set by AddEdge) |
| `confidence` | string | `verified` | `inferred` | `hint` |
| `evidence` | object | free-form evidence (probe, simulator, finding ids) |
| `exposure` | string | exposure width: `wide` | `narrow` | `trusted` | `private` |
| `exposure_cidrs` | []string | public sources that reach the resource |
| `exposure_reason` | string | why the exposure is trusted / private |

Confidence (decision recorded in docs/iam/evaluator.md "Edge confidence rule"): `verified` = an Allow from complete documents that are all exact (collected, or the exact built-in AdministratorAccess) with no undecidable condition and a known resource-policy and SCP status, a typed inventory relationship no collected guardrail denies, or probe/simulator evidence; `inferred` = an Allow resting on unknown or approximate inputs (approximated managed policy, synthesised trust, default KMS key policy, incomplete principal, unknown SCPs, unknown cross-account caller) or any Unknown decision; `hint` = the statement heuristic fallback for documents the evaluator cannot parse, a scanner hint, or name/tag inference. Confidence is the only edge-level trust attribute.

`validation` is reserved, not an edge key: `model.ValidationResult{status, probe_kind, evidence, at}` with status `theoretical` | `validated` | `refuted` | `unverifiable` (default `theoretical`) is the probe-status contract for paths and hops (plan v3 G3 / AP9), not yet attached.
